project_1_description: 2D Multiplayer Online Game with Flutter, Firebase and Node.js.
project_1_Longdescription: Tama Plants is a 2D online multiplayer game platform designed with a scalable architecture using Flutter (client), Firebase (authentication), MySQL (structured data), and Node.js (server logic). Players can acquire, evolve, and collect creatures while interacting within a persistent multiplayer environment. The backend is divided into two Node.js modules: a RESTful API server and a dedicated server for real-time gameplay, optimizing scalability and performance in production environments.
project_2_description: Angular 17 application with modular architecture and integration with JSON Server.
project_2_Longdescription: Web application developed in Angular 17 that allows searching and filtering hotels. It uses a modular architecture to facilitate maintenance and scalability, and integrates with JSON Server to simulate a RESTful API.
project_3_Longdescription: Online pet products store created with Shopify. It implements a dropshipping business model, allowing customers to purchase products without the need to maintain their own inventory. The store is optimized for a smooth and secure user experience.
project_4_description: NFT collection, digital art with AI.
project_4_Longdescription: NFT collection created using blockchain technology. Each NFT represents a unique piece of digital art, generated using artificial intelligence. Users can explore, buy and sell these artworks in a decentralized marketplace.
